name: Chloridon
description: The most powerful green dragon in the Vintaran forest.

description_citations.text: "The Dragons of Magic". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Deadalus raises four dragons as undead; Destruction drinks Chloridon's blood and kills Deadalus.
timeline.quote: Destruction finally returns to Deadalus and kills him.
